notesEn: Terms of Service and Privacy: new mandatory checkbox screen on login, before entering. New "What's new" section in Settings > Updates. Anime page: new "Themes" tab with openings/endings (and episode range), also available on franchise pages. Sources: more reliable audio/subtitle tags (Multi-Audio/Multi-Sub no longer show up incorrectly, more subtitle languages recognized), "Multi Pack" tag repositioned, larger text. Player: thumbnail preview when hovering the progress bar (within what's already downloaded).
